turns.prompt: Fit the nonlinear model y = exp(-b1*x)/(b2+b3*x) to the data in chwirut2.csv (columns x, y) by least squares, starting from b1 = 0.1, b2 = 0.01, b3 = 0.02. Report every parameter (b1, b2, b3) to at least 6 significant digits and the residual sum of squares as rss.

provenance: NIST StRD Chwirut2 (public domain), data copied verbatim
